title: ZEGAMA – AIZKORRI — Golden Trail World Series race page
claims: The series page calls Zegama-Aizkorri 'The Basque Fever' and describes it as a unique experience where thousands of passionate fans create a festive atmosphere along the 42 km course.
The same page gives the race as 42 km with 2,745 m of accumulated height gain and 500 participants, while its prose describes 2,736 m of positive elevation.
The same page's 2026 ranking lists Elhousine Elazzaoui first in 3:45:07 with 212 points, Daniel Pattis second in 3:45:27 with 200 points and Taylor Stack third in 3:52:19 with 176 points.
The same page's schedule gives the 09:00 start, the first men at the finish at 12:30, the first women at 13:15 and the award ceremony at 14:00.

The same page's 2026 men's ranking continues to tenth place: 4th Manuel Merillas 3:53:16 (174), 5th Robert Pkemoi Matayango 3:53:29 (156), 6th Remi Bonnet 3:53:59 (166), 7th Maximilien Drion du Chapois 3:55:08 (144), 8th Benjamin Roubiol 3:55:22 (140), 9th Aitor Ajuria 3:57:58 (144), 10th Antonio Martínez 3:58:21 (139).

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 Golden Trail World Series 官方赛事页全文，抄录赛事描述、42 km / 2,745 m / 500 人、正文 2,736 m 的另一种说法、2026 排名与积分、以及当天时间表。
